+//! PostgreSQL reads for selected entities, using one repeatable-read snapshot.
+
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+use crate::{
+    domain::{
+        models::entity_details::{
+            EntityDetails, EntityIdentity, EntityReference, FunderIdentity, HistoryPage,
+            MemberIdentity, RecordedDeclaration, RecordedFunding,
+        },
+        repositories::entity_details_repository::{EntityDetailsRepo, EntityDetailsRepoError},
+    },
+    outbound::ExposedDatabase,
+};
+
+impl EntityDetailsRepo for ExposedDatabase {
+    async fn get_entity_details(
+        &self,
+        reference: &EntityReference,
+        page: HistoryPage,
+    ) -> Result<Option<EntityDetails>, EntityDetailsRepoError> {
+        read_details(self, reference, page)
+            .await
+            .map_err(|error| EntityDetailsRepoError(error.to_string()))
+    }
+}
+
+async fn read_details(
+    db: &ExposedDatabase,
+    reference: &EntityReference,
+    page: HistoryPage,
+) -> Result<Option<EntityDetails>, sqlx::Error> {
+    let mut transaction = db.pool().begin().await?;
+    sqlx::query("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY")
+        .execute(&mut *transaction)
+        .await?;
+
+    let member_id = reference.member_id();
+    let funder_name = reference.funder_name();
+    let entity = if let Some(id) = member_id {
+        sqlx::query!(
+            "SELECT parliament_member_id, name, party_id, party_name, latest_house,
+                    latest_membership_from, is_current_commons
+             FROM exposed.members WHERE parliament_member_id = $1",
+            id,
+        )
+        .fetch_optional(&mut *transaction)
+        .await?
+        .map(|row| {
+            EntityIdentity::Member(MemberIdentity {
+                member_id: row.parliament_member_id,
+                name: row.name,
+                party_id: row.party_id,
+                party_name: row.party_name,
+                latest_house: row.latest_house,
+                latest_membership_from: row.latest_membership_from,
+                is_current_commons: row.is_current_commons,
+            })
+        })
+    } else {
+        sqlx::query!(
+            "SELECT funder_name, funder_kind, company_number
+             FROM exposed.funders WHERE funder_name = $1",
+            funder_name,
+        )
+        .fetch_optional(&mut *transaction)
+        .await?
+        .map(|row| {
+            EntityIdentity::Funder(FunderIdentity {
+                name: row.funder_name,
+                funder_kind: row.funder_kind,
+                company_number: row.company_number,
+            })
+        })
+    };
+    let Some(entity) = entity else {
+        transaction.commit().await?;
+        return Ok(None);
+    };
+
+    // EXISTS selects declarations without duplicating them for repeated funding.
+    // Do not join service periods: one MP may have several of those.
+    let mut declarations: Vec<RecordedDeclaration> = sqlx::query!(
+        "SELECT d.source_declaration_id, d.category_id, d.category_name,
+                (d.registration_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS registration_date,
+                d.fetched_at, m.parliament_member_id, m.name, m.party_id, m.party_name,
+                m.latest_house, m.latest_membership_from, m.is_current_commons
+         FROM exposed.declarations d
+         JOIN exposed.members m ON m.id = d.member_id
+         WHERE ($1::integer IS NOT NULL AND m.parliament_member_id = $1)
+            OR ($2::text IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
+                SELECT 1 FROM exposed.funding_entries fe
+                JOIN exposed.funders f ON f.id = fe.funder_id
+                WHERE fe.source_declaration_id = d.source_declaration_id
+                  AND f.funder_name = $2
+            ))
+         ORDER BY d.registration_date DESC NULLS LAST, d.source_declaration_id DESC
+         LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4",
+        member_id,
+        funder_name,
+        i64::from(page.limit()) + 1,
+        i64::from(page.offset()),
+    )
+    .fetch_all(&mut *transaction)
+    .await?
+    .into_iter()
+    .map(|row| RecordedDeclaration {
+        source_declaration_id: row.source_declaration_id,
+        member: MemberIdentity {
+            member_id: row.parliament_member_id,
+            name: row.name,
+            party_id: row.party_id,
+            party_name: row.party_name,
+            latest_house: row.latest_house,
+            latest_membership_from: row.latest_membership_from,
+            is_current_commons: row.is_current_commons,
+        },
+        category_id: row.category_id,
+        category_name: row.category_name,
+        registration_date: row.registration_date,
+        fetched_at: row.fetched_at,
+        funding_entries: Vec::new(),
+    })
+    .collect();
+
+    let has_more = declarations.len() > usize::from(page.limit());
+    declarations.truncate(usize::from(page.limit()));
+    let declaration_ids: Vec<i32> = declarations
+        .iter()
+        .map(|declaration| declaration.source_declaration_id)
+        .collect();
+    let mut funding_by_declaration: HashMap<i32, Vec<RecordedFunding>> = HashMap::new();
+    for row in sqlx::query!(
+        "SELECT fe.source_declaration_id, fe.amount::text AS amount,
+                fe.currency, fe.payment_type, f.funder_name, f.funder_kind, f.company_number
+         FROM exposed.funding_entries fe
+         LEFT JOIN exposed.funders f ON f.id = fe.funder_id
+         WHERE fe.source_declaration_id = ANY($1)
+         ORDER BY fe.source_declaration_id, fe.id",
+        &declaration_ids,
+    )
+    .fetch_all(&mut *transaction)
+    .await?
+    {
+        let funder = row.funder_name.map(|name| FunderIdentity {
+            name,
+            funder_kind: row.funder_kind,
+            company_number: row.company_number,
+        });
+        funding_by_declaration
+            .entry(row.source_declaration_id)
+            .or_default()
+            .push(RecordedFunding {
+                funder,
+                amount: row.amount,
+                currency: row.currency,
+                payment_type: row.payment_type,
+            });
+    }
+    for declaration in &mut declarations {
+        declaration.funding_entries = funding_by_declaration
+            .remove(&declaration.source_declaration_id)
+            .unwrap_or_default();
+    }
+
+    transaction.commit().await?;
+    Ok(Some(EntityDetails {
+        entity,
+        declarations,
+        has_more,
+    }))
+}

*** Add File: /Users/jamie/development/exposed-entity-details/docs/api/entity-details.md
+# Member and funder detail endpoints
+
+Search results now include `reference` and `details_url` alongside the existing
+`name`, `kind` and `funder_kind` fields. Follow `details_url` against the API origin
+to retrieve that entity. Through the frontend's development proxy, prefix it
+with `/api`.
+
+```json
+{
+  "name": "Casey Example",
+  "kind": "MP",
+  "funder_kind": null,
+  "reference": "1",
+  "details_url": "/members/1"
+}
+```
+
+## Routes and identity
+
+| Method and path | Reference |
+| --- | --- |
+| `GET /members/{member_id}` | Positive Parliament member ID, up to 2147483647. |
+| `GET /funders/{reference}` | Unpadded URL-safe Base64 of the exact funder name's UTF-8 bytes. |
+
+Treat a reference together with its entity kind. Prefer the URL returned by
+search over constructing one. A funder reference preserves case, spaces,
+Unicode and punctuation. It identifies an exact recorded name, not a resolved
+company or person. Case variants stay separate. Replacing funding entries during
+an import does not change the reference. If the stored funder name is removed
+or corrected, its old reference returns 404.
+
+## Query parameters
+
+Both endpoints accept:
+
+| Parameter | Default | Accepted values |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `limit` | `50` | Integer from 1 to 100 declarations. |
+| `offset` | `0` | Integer from 0 to 2147483647 declarations to skip. |
+
+Declarations are ordered by registration timestamp descending, with source
+declaration ID descending for ties. Undated declarations come last. A page
+counts declarations, not funding items. Follow `pagination.next_offset` with
+the same limit until it is `null`. Pagination is deterministic for unchanged
+data; an import between requests can move records between pages.
+
+## Response
+
+Each response contains `entity`, `declarations` and `pagination`:
+
+- An MP's `entity` includes `kind: "MP"`, `reference`, `details_url`, `member_id`,
+  `name`, `party_id`, `party_name`, `latest_house`, `latest_membership_from` and
+  `is_current_commons`. House 1 means Commons and 2 means Lords. A membership
+  location is only a constituency when the latest House is Commons. Party and
+  membership fields describe the latest stored identity.
+- A funder's `entity` includes `kind: "Funder"`, `reference`, `details_url`,
+  `name`, nullable `funder_kind` and nullable `company_number`. Company numbers
+  are strings so leading zeros remain intact.
+- Each declaration includes `source_declaration_id`, a `source_url` linking to
+  the Parliament Interests API, the owning `member`, `category_id`,
+  `category_name`, nullable `registration_date`, `fetched_at` and
+  `funding_entries`. The nested member has the MP identity fields above without
+  `kind`. Registration dates use `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC; fetch timestamps use
+  RFC 3339. Missing registration dates remain `null`.
+- Each funding item includes a nullable `funder` identity, nullable `amount`,
+  nullable `currency` and nullable `payment_type`. The nested funder has the
+  funder identity fields above without `kind`. Amounts are exact decimal
+  strings. Repeated funding items retain their multiplicity.
+- `pagination` contains the requested `limit` and `offset`, plus `next_offset`
+  or `null` when no more declarations exist.
+
+An MP history includes declarations with no funding items. A funder history
+includes each declaration attributed to that exact funder once, with **all**
+its funding items, including those attributed to other funders. Use the nested
+funder reference to distinguish the selected funder's items from this context.
+Other currencies and unknown amounts remain visible.
+
+Identity and evidence within one response use a single committed database
+snapshot. An existing entity with no declarations, or an offset beyond its
+history, returns 200 with an empty `declarations` array. These reads use stored
+data and do not trigger an import. Financial summaries and history filters are
+later API increments.
+
+## Errors
+
+| Status | Meaning |
+| --- | --- |
+| `400` | A query parameter cannot be parsed, such as `limit=hello` or `offset=-1`. |
+| `422` | Invalid member/funder reference or history bounds. |
+| `404` | A valid reference has no stored entity. |
+| `503` | The detail read failed. Diagnostic details remain in server logs. |
+
+Error bodies are plain text, consistent with the existing API.
+
+## Try the search-to-detail flow
+
+With the API running on port 6999 and imported data available:
+
+```sh
+member_path=$(curl -fsS 'http://localhost:6999/search?term=John&max_entries=10' |
+  jq -er '[.entities[] | select(.kind == "MP")][0].details_url')
+curl -fsS "http://localhost:6999${member_path}?limit=5"
+
+funder_path=$(curl -fsS 'http://localhost:6999/search?term=HSBC&max_entries=10' |
+  jq -er '[.entities[] | select(.kind == "Funder")][0].details_url')
+curl -fsS "http://localhost:6999${funder_path}?limit=5"
+```
+
+## Verification
+
+The new endpoint tests create disposable SQLx databases from the existing
+baseline and `db/fixtures/entity_details.sql`. They exercise the production
+router, search selection, exact-name identity, null values, decimal precision,
+duplicate funding, stable pagination and a concurrent import. A fake read port
+also verifies application failures and public error redaction.
+
+Run from the repository root with local PostgreSQL available:
+
+```sh
+export DATABASE_URL='REDACTED'
+cargo fmt --all -- --check
+cargo check --all-targets
+cargo test --test entity_details
+```
+
+SQLx checks queries against the configured schema during compilation. The
+database role must be allowed to create disposable test databases. `cargo test`
+also runs the existing integration test, which expects imported HSBC records
+in the database configured by `exposed/config/test.yaml`.
*** Update File: /Users/jamie/development/exposed-entity-details/README.md
@@

import json
from pathlib import Path

import time
